claims.hypothesis: Reddened quasars host large cold dust and gas reservoirs
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 3 continuum and CO(3-2) of four quasars
claims.result: All four detected; SFR >~1000 Msun/yr, gas 1-5e10 Msun
claims.finding: Gas-rich, dusty starburst hosts with short depletion times

evidence.quote: All four quasars are detected in both the dust continuum and in the $^{12}$CO(3-2) line.

claims.hypothesis: ULASJ2315+0143 gas is resolved and kinematically ordered
claims.result: Velocity gradient over ~20 kpc, i=57 deg
claims.finding: Consistent with rotating disk but mergers not excluded

evidence.quote: The velocity field is consistent with a rotationally supported gas disk but other scenarios, e.g. mergers, cannot be ruled out

claims.hypothesis: Reddened quasars are intermediate between SMGs and optical quasars
claims.result: Gas properties consistent with both; intermediate gas fractions under assumptions

evidence.quote: It therefore seems plausible that reddened quasars are being seen as they are transitioning to optical quasars from starburst galaxies.
